gene.purpose: Make the Foundation the project's inherited gene, not an external authority or an ever-growing lock system.
immutable_root_goals: preserve user choice and control as the fundamental goal
preserve Foundation as the highest root principle
gene.evolution_principle: implementation may evolve freely when it remains compatible with the immutable root goals
gene.root_conflict_definition: A root conflict is a fundamental abandonment or weakening of an immutable root goal, not an implementation change, technology replacement, workflow change, or ordinary feature tradeoff.
forbidden_root_conflicts: weakening user choice as a fundamental goal
replacing Foundation with a lower-level implementation preference

inheritance_contract.fork: inherit unless the descendant explicitly leaves the AngelaNexus identity chain
inheritance_contract.migration: identity survives repository, platform, organization, and technology migration
inheritance_contract.split: descendants carrying AngelaNexus identity or core lineage inherit the gene
inheritance_contract.implementation: ordinary implementation changes do not require governance re-authorization of the root

derivation_requirements.architecture: must explain how major architectural decisions derive from or remain compatible with the gene
derivation_requirements.security: must preserve the root goals while enforcing safety boundaries
derivation_requirements.ux: must preserve user visibility, choice, control, and revocability
derivation_requirements.release: must verify gene compatibility before release
derivation_requirements.documentation: must distinguish immutable root goals from evolving implementation rules

change_classification.structural: normal evolution; verify compatibility and migration impact
change_classification.root_goal_change: constitutional/root-level change; not an ordinary implementation change
